kind: Evidence for the October 5, 2026 repair of the nightly quickstart check. Metadata only: key identities, times, scopes and states from the service's administration view and the keyring item's own timestamps; no key value was read into this record or printed.

cause.nightly_log: ~/.le-ci-tmp/quickstart-cron.log: 5 of 5 passed at 05:40 UTC on September 27, 28 and 29; 0 of 5 from September 30 to October 5, every quickstart stopping at connected with 401 unauthorized.
cause.conclusion: The keys issued on September 22 for seven days expired on September 29 at 18:02:01 UTC and nothing renewed them. The keyring item was last written at the second the service created the expired key, no later key existed, and a key issued for the same account on October 5 passed all five quickstarts at once.

dependency: The renewal signs with the baltor-admin key, which no renewal can replace. The takeover checkpoint of September 20, 2026 records that it expires on October 20, 2026; the service reports no expiry for host keys. After that date the renewal exits 3 with administrator_credential_refused and the diagnostic keys lapse within seven days.
